body:
The re-admission reached a verdict this time, and it is a failure inside the suite rather than a bound.

RESULT: FAIL (rc=2, manager_rc=2, collected). The whole run finished INSIDE the new bounds - service runtime 44min 56.586s against the 3600 s cap; the 3570 s inner bound was never approached - and make ledgercheck-selftest reported Error 1 from a genuine test error.

THE ONE FAILING TARGET: ledgercheck-selftest. The failing test is test_float_hardening.PlantedTree.test_counterexamples, subtest plant='L-G-generated', which ERRORED: its probe subprocess 'make energydoccheck' exceeded the test harness's OWN internal 600-second per-probe timeout (TimeoutExpired raised through the two-worker process pool; site test_float_hardening.py run_one line 328 into run_case line 205). This timeout lives in the test, not in the card or the unit.

EVERYTHING ELSE PASSED: five sub-suites OK before it - generated producer failures (5 tests), float motion (5), float claims (70), float runner policy (3), attestation shape (14) - and the plant-anchor test ok (one benign ResourceWarning, an unclosed read of docs.json at float_plants.py:380). The plant board ran 38 fast-mode cases on 2 workers: every control case is GREEN (the L-control family, W-control-senses, S-control-code, and the M5-landing trio) and every decided corruption plant is RED - detected as designed. L-G-generated is the sole undecided case: it errored on the internal probe timeout before reaching a verdict.

MEASURED WALL AND CPU AT FOUR CPUS (the recording duty): wall 2696.586 s service runtime (the hardening module itself reports 2695.318 s); CPU 6299.215 s; memory peak 2.8G, swap 0. The binding constraint is therefore not the card: a single probe inside one planted case outgrew the test's own 600 s subprocess ceiling even at the wider allowance. How that ceiling, the probe, or the case should be disposed is a source-side or test-side question for Sciences and you; nothing retries from this seat.

STATE: grant 89225d75eed3-u3gate-b-1018172539 consumed by this single attempt (launched 00:28:19Z at grant age 160 s, inside validity); collection clean; Bunpublished-local-ref:e9671acd244849c5, B/home, B/bin and the u3b cache removed and independently verified absent; B/src is KEPT per the FAIL rule at 5f96f32e, clean, still anchored by u3-a3-replacement-1018 in the clone (re-verified after the run). No retry, no repair, no second grant. v9 evidence hashed in B/evidence-hashes.txt; v8 evidence remains preserved in B-v8-evidence/.

links.what: The single v9 re-admission executed once under the grant and card v9; failed on a real test verdict (internal per-probe timeout) inside all bounds; reported with full evidence; no retry.
The card-v8 preparation/grant arc it instructed was executed, failed on the 870 s bound, and was superseded by CO ruling and card v9; the v9 arc is now fully reported.
